app.name: MG Holding Portal
app.loadFailedText: The connection may have dropped. Nothing was lost.

offline.title: No signal
offline.text: You are seeing what was last saved on this device. Changes cannot be sent until the signal is back.

update.title: A new version is ready
update.text: Update to get the latest changes. What you are typing now will be lost, so finish first.

offline.title: No connection
offline.text: This page is not saved on your device yet. Nothing was lost. Check your signal and try again.

accent.label: Company accent
accent.help: Every company supplies one accent colour. Switch it to check that the whole system still holds.

field.subject: Subject
field.subjectHelp: One line. What is wrong, and where.
field.subjectError: Enter a subject so the support team can route this ticket.
field.descriptionHelp: Add the steps you took and anything you can see on screen.
field.teamHelp: Pick the team that owns this kind of request.
field.notifyEmail: Email me when this ticket changes
field.notifyEmailHelp: Only for changes to tickets you opened.
field.notifySms: Text me when a ticket is urgent
field.offlineModeHelp: Stores the last version on this device. Useful at sites with no signal.

ticket.sampleSubject: Weighbridge terminal will not print tickets
ticket.sampleBody: The terminal at the north gate accepts a load and shows the weight, but nothing comes out of the printer. Drivers are queuing. We have restarted the terminal twice.
ticket.sampleProvenance: Last changed by Y. El-Shal, 7 Oct 2026 at 14:05 Cairo time.

announcement.author: Published by
announcement.sampleBody: The HQ shuttle will leave fifteen minutes earlier on working days from Sunday. The last return from the Abu Tartur site moves to 17:30.

notification.title: Notifications
notification.lead: What happened to your tickets, bookings and announcements.
notification.emptyText: New notifications appear here, and in the bell at the top.

resolved.title: {number}: is your problem solved?
resolved.detail: {subject}. IT marked it as resolved. Tell us if it is fixed.

confirmReminder.title: Reminder: is {number} solved?
confirmReminder.detail: {subject}. IT is waiting for your answer.

infected.title: A file was blocked: {fileName}
infected.detail: It failed the malware scan and was deleted. Do not open your own copy; IT has been told.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.lead: Choose how you hear about each kind of event. Anything you leave on reaches you both ways.

hints.tickets: A ticket you raised or were given, replies and status changes, and tickets running out of time.
hints.bookings: Confirmations of your bookings, and a booking cancelled by someone else.
hints.announcements: When an announcement for you is pinned.

table.caption: Open tickets assigned to the IT team, newest first.
table.scrollHint: Scroll the table sideways to see every column.

tabs.label: Ticket views
tabs.panelMine: Tickets you opened appear here, newest first.
tabs.panelAll: Every ticket in the company you can see.

empty.noTicketsText: Nothing in this queue needs you right now. New tickets appear here as soon as they are opened.
empty.noResultsText: Check the spelling, or search for a person's name instead of their job title.

dialog.assignBody: The ticket moves to your name and the current owner is told. You can hand it back at any time.
dialog.deleteBody: The ticket and its history are removed for everyone in the company. This cannot be undone.

toast.savedText: The support team has been notified.
toast.offlineText: Your changes are kept on this device and will be sent when the signal returns.
toast.failedText: The connection dropped. Nothing was lost; try again.

notice.formErrorTitle: This ticket cannot be sent yet
notice.formErrorText: One field needs your attention. It is marked below.
notice.slaTitle: This ticket is past its SLA
notice.slaText: It was due at 12:00 Cairo time. The facilities lead has been told.

upload.prompt: Choose files or drop them here
upload.hint: Photos or PDFs, up to 10 MB each. On a weak signal, send one at a time.

mock.lead: Development sign-in. Pick someone to see the portal as they do. None of these people is real.
mock.offText: It only answers while the server runs with NODE_ENV=development.

entra.lead: Use the Microsoft work account your company gave you.
entra.note: You will go to Microsoft to sign in, then come straight back here.

failed.title: Could not sign in
failed.text: The connection may have dropped. Try again.

signin_failed.title: Sign-in did not finish
signin_failed.text: Microsoft did not confirm who you are. Try again.

not_provisioned.title: You are not set up on the portal yet
not_provisioned.text: Your Microsoft account worked, but it has no portal profile. Ask your company admin to add you.

too_many_attempts.title: Too many sign-ins
too_many_attempts.text: This account has signed in too many times in a short while. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.

consent_required.title: The portal needs approval in Microsoft
consent_required.text: Microsoft says the portal has not been approved for your organisation yet. Ask your Global Administrator to grant admin consent to the portal's app registration (Microsoft Graph, User.Read) in Entra ID, under Enterprise applications, Permissions.

not_assigned.title: Your account is not assigned to the portal
not_assigned.text: Microsoft only lets assigned people into the portal. Ask your Global Administrator to assign you, or a group you are in, to the portal in Entra ID, under Enterprise applications, Users and groups.

app_setup.title: The portal's Microsoft sign-in is not set up correctly
app_setup.text: Microsoft refused the portal itself, not your account. Ask your Global Administrator to check the portal's app registration: its client secret may have expired, or its redirect address may not be registered. Tell them the time you tried.

cancelled.title: Sign-in was cancelled
cancelled.text: You left the Microsoft sign-in before it finished. Try again when you are ready.

company_not_set_up.title: Your company is not set up in the portal
company_not_set_up.text: Microsoft confirmed who you are, but your email domain does not belong to any company in the portal yet, so nothing was created for you. Ask the portal's holding administrator to add your company and its email domain.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.text: Your role does not include it. If you need it for your work, ask your company admin.

pending.text: This part of the portal is not open yet. It will appear here when it is ready.

network.title: No connection
network.text: The request did not get through. Check your signal and try again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this
forbidden.text: Your role does not allow it. Ask your company admin if you need it.

notFound.title: This could not be found
notFound.text: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another company.

invalid.title: Some details are not valid
invalid.text: Check what you entered and try again.

conflict.title: This conflicts with an existing record
conflict.text: Reload to see the latest version, then try again.

tooLarge.title: That is too large to send
tooLarge.text: Try a smaller file, or send fewer at a time.

rateLimited.title: Too many requests
rateLimited.text: Wait a minute, then try again.

server.title: Something went wrong on our side
server.text: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, tell IT support.

search.failed: Search is not available right now.

picker.full: No more than {count} people can be chosen.
picker.failed: People could not be searched. Check your signal and try again.

tk.lead: Ask IT for help and follow what you have asked for.

new.title: What do you need help with?
new.lead: Tell IT what is wrong. It takes a minute.
new.categoryError: Choose what it is about, so the right person sees it.
new.subjectHelp: One line: what is wrong, and where.
new.descriptionHelp: What happened, and what do you see on screen? Paste a screenshot here with Ctrl+V.
new.descriptionError: Say what is wrong, so IT can start without asking you again.
new.filesHelp: Up to {count} files. Photos, screenshots, PDF and Office files.
new.noCategoriesText: The helpdesk has no categories for your company yet. Ask your company admin.

done.title: Your request was sent
done.text: Keep this number if you phone IT or ask about it.
done.filesFailedText: The ticket is sent. Open it and add the file again.

open.title: No open tickets
open.text: Anything you ask IT for will appear here.

closed.title: No closed tickets yet
closed.text: Solved tickets stay here for you to look back on.

search.title: Nothing matches
search.text: Try the ticket number or a word from the subject.

detail.missingText: It may belong to someone else, or the link is wrong.

event.notSolved: {name} said it is still a problem
event.closedByLead: {name} closed it without the requester’s confirmation

entry.internalHelp: Only the support team can see this.

reopen.text: If it is not fixed, you can reopen it until {until} ({days} days after it was solved).
reopen.staffText: Reopen it if the problem came back.
reopen.lateText: The time to reopen it has passed. Please open a new ticket.
reopen.closedText: It was closed. Please open a new ticket if you need help again.
reopen.failed: The ticket could not be reopened
reopen.notYoursText: Only the agent this ticket is assigned to, or a Lead, can reopen it.
reopen.staffResolvedText: The requester has been asked whether it is solved. The ticket stays open and its SLA clock keeps running. Reopen it if the problem came back.

reply.title: Add a reply
reply.label: Your reply
reply.internalHelp: Only the support team will see this note. The requester will not.
reply.insertHelp: Inserted in {language}, the requester’s language. Edit it before you send.
reply.notYours: This ticket is assigned to someone else. You can add an internal note; only the assignee or a Lead answers the requester.

side.label: Handling this ticket
side.notYours: Only the agent this ticket is assigned to, or a Lead, can change these.

error.reopenWindow: The time to reopen this ticket has passed.
error.notResolved: This ticket is not resolved, so there is nothing to do here.
error.tooMany: A message can carry up to 5 files.
error.unsupportedFile: This kind of file is not accepted. Photos, PDF, Office files and text are.
error.tooLargeSize: The file is too large (up to {size}).
error.leadOnly: Only an IT lead can assign or reassign a ticket.
error.unknownLocation: Choose a location from the list.
error.unknownRequester: That person is not in the directory, or this team does not serve their company.
error.unknownAssignee: That person is not on this team.
error.dateTaken: There is already a holiday on that date.
error.unknownUser: That person is not in the directory.
error.lastLead: The IT team needs at least one active lead. Make someone else a lead first.
error.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
error.alreadyRated: This ticket has already been rated, and a rating cannot change.
error.ownWork: You cannot confirm or rate a ticket you worked on yourself.

queue.title: Queue
queue.caption: IT queue
queue.pickAll: Select every ticket on this page

log.title: Log a ticket for someone
log.whoHelp: Search the directory. The ticket is theirs and the answer goes to them.

cfg.name: Name
cfg.noTeams: No support team is set up yet.
cfg.defaultPriorityHelp: What the form preselects. The person asking can still change it.

members.help: Who works in the IT Helpdesk. Leads assign tickets and keep IT settings. Someone you add uses the IT Helpdesk instead of the portal from their next click; someone you remove comes back to the portal.
members.removeBody: {name} will leave the IT Helpdesk and come back to the portal. Tickets assigned to them stay assigned until a lead moves them.

categories.help: What people choose from when they ask for help.

locations.help: Sites and offices people can pick. Take a location out of use rather than deleting it.

targets.help: How quickly IT aims to answer, counted in working hours only.
targets.slaHelp: In working hours. A change reaches a ticket the next time its status or priority changes.
targets.invalid: Every target must be more than zero.
targets.order: The first reply cannot be due after the solution.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.help: The clock only runs inside these hours, on these days, outside holidays.
hours.invalid: Choose at least one day, and an end time after the start.

holidays.help: Days the clock does not run. They apply to every company.
holidays.deleteBody: “{name}” will count as a working day again.

replies.help: Ready-made answers. They are inserted in the language of the person asking, and edited before sending.

confirm.title: Is your problem solved?
confirm.text: IT marked this ticket as resolved on {when}. Tell us whether it is really fixed. The ticket stays open until you answer.
confirm.rateHelp: 1 star is poor, 5 stars is excellent.
confirm.ratingError: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars.
confirm.reasonHelp: A short reason. The ticket goes back to IT.
confirm.reasonError: Tell IT what is still wrong.
confirm.doneYes: Thank you. The ticket is closed.
confirm.doneNo: The ticket is back with IT.

closed.confirmedYou: You confirmed that this ticket is solved.
closed.leadYou: IT closed this ticket without your confirmation.
closed.leadStaff: Closed without the requester’s confirmation. Reason: {reason}

close.title: Close without the requester’s confirmation?
close.text: Use this when the requester does not answer. The reason stays on the ticket and in the audit log, and the reports count the ticket apart.
close.reasonHelp: For example: the requester is not responding.
close.reasonError: Write the reason for closing it.

email.why: You are receiving this email because of your notification settings.

outbox.title: Mail outbox (development)
outbox.lead: Every email the portal would have sent. Nothing leaves this machine while Graph is mocked.
outbox.empty: No mail has been sent yet.
outbox.unavailable: This page exists only in development, with the mocked Graph.

lead.queue: Every ticket the IT team serves, nearest deadline first.
lead.assigned: The tickets assigned to you, nearest deadline first.
lead.reports: What came in and how the team did against its targets.
lead.settings: Categories, targets, working hours, locations, holidays and canned replies. Every change is recorded.
lead.new: Something you need IT for yourself. It goes to the queue like anyone else’s.
lead.mine: The tickets you raised for yourself.

noAccess.title: The IT Helpdesk is for the IT team
noAccess.text: Only IT agents and leads can open it. To ask IT for help, raise a ticket in the portal.

reports.badRange: Choose a start date on or before the end date.
reports.businessNote: Times count working hours only, as the targets do.
reports.satisfactionNote: Tickets closed {from} to {to}. Only tickets the requester confirmed carry a rating.
reports.closedByLead: Closed by a lead without confirmation
reports.noClosed: No ticket was closed in these dates.
